scenario.question: A colleague wants to use an LLM to automatically summarize confidential client contracts and email the summaries to the whole team. What is the most appropriate response?
options: Approve the workflow — LLMs are reliable for summarization
Suggest adding a human review step and restricting distribution to authorized personnel only
Refuse to use AI for any legal documents under any circumstances
Suggest using a different, larger model for better accuracy
